# Voidmail MCP Email

> `@voidly/mcp-email` 1.2.0 is a Node.js 20+ local stdio MCP server with 19 tools for `@voidmail.ai` agent inboxes.

Install in an MCP host with `npx -y @voidly/mcp-email@1.2.0`. New inboxes created by this package use an owner-approved recipient list. The agent and owner keys are separate; keep the owner key outside the agent's reach. Send limits and policy are enforced by the API. Save an operation ID before `voidmail_send_once`, use `voidmail_send_status` after uncertainty, and do not equate provider acceptance with delivery. A hosted `/mcp/mail` route has not yet been verified.

## Documentation

- [Package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/voidly-ai/mcp-email/main/README.md): Setup, tools, owner control, limits, and durable sends.
- [Published npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@voidly/mcp-email): Installable package and version.

## Source

- [Source repository](https://github.com/voidly-ai/mcp-email): Package source, tests, and license.
